author: Saniy
body:
Hello, im Sanirius

I have been banned for 1-2 years for advertising.

I think im unfairly banned. Because i havent been advertising at all. (I think)

I really like this server and i hope i can get unbanned. I really didnt mean to advertise. And the Admin/Mod Riskayyy  could atleast give me temporarily ban. A ban that never expires is a little bit to much i think. If i get unbanned i wont advertise anymore and wont break the rules.

So i hope i can get unbanned! :P

-Sanirius

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing you infraction, I've decided to lift your punishment. I believe that you have waited for long enough, thus your infraction will be appealed. Please read the rules again and make sure this doesn't happen in the future: https://www.avicus.net/rules

Best Regards, 
Zeusy,
Avicus Senior Moderator
